basic_info.description: Fully occupied 4 unit building in the highly desirable Inner Richmond District. Your investment starts with the largest lot on the block. Offer tenants a spacious, shared backyard with a grassy patio area. Each unit is separately metered for PG&E and offers a private garage with storage. There is a separate common laundry area for additional income potential.  Each unit is generously sized, offers higher ceilings, an eat-in kitchen and fireplace.    Steps from Golden Gate Park for biking, disc golf, pickleball, picnics or leisurely walks. Surrounded by 4 star rated cafes, bakeries and restaurants such as Burma Superstar, Arsicault Bakery, Good Luck Dim Sum, Bella Trattoria, Beanstalk Cafe and more.  Shopping and public transit is a breeze. Conveniently located to University of San Francisco. Investors and 1031 Exchanges welcome!
